metadata.description: Godot 4 tooling for Claude Code — a runtime bridge that lets an agent press play, see the running game, drive input and read real errors, plus headless scene authoring and game-design skills.

plugins.name: godot
plugins.description: Close the loop on Godot 4 development: launch the game, screenshot it, inject input, read script errors with res:// line numbers, step frames deterministically, author scenes headless so Godot serialises the .tscn itself, and design games with version-pinned Godot 4.7 knowledge for both 2D and 3D.
